name: package-manager: a version with no hash
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "names a package manager pinned by version alone"

name: package-manager: any package manager
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "accepts one exact version with the sha512 hash"

name: package-manager: an empty field
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "names a root with no packageManager field"

name: package-manager: half a version
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "a range, a tag or half a version"

name: package-manager: a hash in capitals
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "names a hash that is too short"

name: package-manager: only the root manifest
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "is asked of the root manifest only"

name: package-manager: it runs with the other gates
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "names a package manager pinned by version alone"

name: package-manager: it is skipped with no root manifest
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "is reported as skipped, never as passed"

name: package-manager: it runs on the one file an editor hook gives
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "judges the root manifest and a package's given alone"

name: pin: the hash in hex
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "prints the version package.json names"

name: pin: says it wrote
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "writes the one line with --write"

name: pin: the version it is given
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "moves to the version it is given"

name: pin: adds a field that is not there
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "adds the field as the first one"

name: pin: nothing to write
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "says it wrote nothing"

name: pin: an exact version
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "refuses a version that is not exact"

name: pin: a registry with no sha512
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "registry has no sha512"

name: pin: outside a project
test: pnpm vitest run kit/ci/pin-package-manager.test.mts -t "refuses outside a project"
